meta.name: Stroke volume vs frequency A (valves)
meta.description: Net per stroke vs frequency and voltage, WITH valves. 1, 100, 200, 400, 700 Hz; bench supply 2.5, 1.5, 1, 0.8 V; bursts sized for ~2.5 mm meniscus travel in the 0.5 mm tube; 2 bursts per cell, 10 s rests; passes down/up; re-centring pauses at the same voltage. Microscope video on the meniscus, frames.csv for timing.

tests.note: Pause 1 (pass 1, down): set the bench supply to 2.500 V. Move the stage so the meniscus has ~6 mm of tube in view AHEAD of it (it moves in the pumping direction), then confirm. Do not touch the stage until the next yellow banner.
